title: DiceCTF 2024 Quals
description:
Play DiceCTF 2024 by DiceGang! We'll be inviting (with travel reimbursement!) the top 8 teams, as well as 4 US high school teams to compete at DiceCTF Finals in New York City!

Register your team now: https://ctf.dicega.ng/

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/dicectf
prizes:
1st place in Quals: $2000
2nd place in Quals: $1000
3rd place in Quals: $500

10 writeup prizes of $100 each
